rationale: Fourth doctrine: the mag is the clock. Hunt the disarmed enemy (target selection by mag state, not distance), stalk to striking range as their mag drains, dash to point-blank for the 95-tick reload window — with true 0.135 bullet drop and taps locked to the fire cooldown. Spar record: 6-0 vs FALCONER, 6-0 vs VEGA.
